mtpcomedie.name: Place de la Comédie
mtpcomedie.slogan: The Egg, where all of Montpellier meets at the Three Graces.
mtpcomedie.line: The Three Graces fountain on the square is a replica made in 1989; the original stands inside the Opéra Comédie.

mtppeyrou.name: Promenade du Peyrou
mtppeyrou.slogan: A royal terrace ending in a water tower and an aqueduct.
mtppeyrou.line: The equestrian statue of Louis XIV that crowns the promenade was inaugurated in 1718.

mtpfabre.name: Musée Fabre
mtpfabre.slogan: Courbet's greeting, framed in a painter's own museum.
mtpfabre.line: Its Courbet collection is among the world's largest, built on Alfred Bruyas's 1868 gift, including the famous 'Bonjour Monsieur Courbet'.

gellone.name: Gellone Abbey
gellone.slogan: Pilgrims' Romanesque cloister tucked inside a rocky gorge.
gellone.line: Founded in 804 by William of Gellone, a cousin of Charlemagne, who gave it a fragment of the True Cross.

setecimetieremarin.name: Cimetière marin, Sète
setecimetieremarin.slogan: Tombs on a hillside, and the sea Valéry could not stop watching.
setecimetieremarin.line: The wind is rising!… We must try to live!
